# Bundled notices

`@cfworker/json-schema` 4.1.1 declares MIT but omits its license file from npm.
Its published `gitHead` is `5409fdc2bd144f68e8b28c61c71fcb16600000a6`.
The adjacent notice is copied from that revision's [LICENSE](https://github.com/cfworker/cfworker/blob/5409fdc2bd144f68e8b28c61c71fcb16600000a6/LICENSE.md).

The build gathers license/notice files for all JavaScript packages actually
included by esbuild and writes `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt` into the companion.
Review notice sources when dependency versions change.
